summary: {person} has finished the home-care visits while the employer is still waiting for reimbursement.
realLife: Denver Labor reported that a home-care worker went unpaid during a Medicaid reimbursement problem and investigators worked with the employer to establish the hours.
gates: A care worker reports unpaid visits and the provider cites a reimbursement delay.
weights: Verified service hours allow the wage inquiry to proceed.
inGame: needs: the confirmed care visits, payroll and reimbursement status.

turns.what: Payroll paid the worker on time.
turns.pulledBy: The provider carried the outstanding invoice itself.
turns.writesBack: The dispute stays with the reimbursement account.

turns.pulledBy: The provider disputes the remaining dates.
turns.writesBack: The worksheet lists the confirmed visits.
